mode.title: Mode
mode.description: notices = live procurement notices with deadlines and contacts, the actionable feed. projects = funded projects with commitments. countries = one row per country with project counts and money.

country.title: Country (optional)
country.description: Short name as the source spells it, e.g. Kenya, Vietnam, Congo, Democratic Republic of. Empty covers every country.

searchTerm.title: Search term (optional)
searchTerm.description: Free text across the record, e.g. water, solar, road, hospital, consultancy.

noticeType.title: Notice types (notices mode)
noticeType.description: Keep only these, e.g. Request for Bids, Request for Expression of Interest, Contract Award. Matches on part of the name.

onlyOpen.title: Only open notices
onlyOpen.description: On by default. Keeps only notices whose submission deadline has not passed.

status.title: Project status (projects mode)
status.description: Active, Closed, Pipeline or Dropped. Empty covers all.

minAmountUsd.title: Minimum commitment in USD
minAmountUsd.description: Projects mode. Drop projects committing less than this. 0 for no floor.

approvedSince.title: Approved since (optional)
approvedSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Projects mode. Keep only projects approved on or after this date.

maxResults.title: Max rows per run
maxResults.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
